1.explanation: This code uses Grommet’s Data component with a toolbar made up of DataSearch and DataFilters. When you type in the search box or choose a status value from the filters drop‐down, the data set updates correctly, but no “Clear Filters” button is rendered alongside them. In the Grommet v2 documentation examples, that button should appear automatically once any filter or search is active, proving the bug scenario.
1.bug_scenario: In a Grommet Data component with a toolbar consisting of a DataSearch and a DataFilters control, when the user types into the search box or applies a drop‐down filter, the "Clear Filters" button never appears in the toolbar area (even though the Grommet documentation examples show it should). This reproduces the screenshots where typing “abc” in the search or choosing a status filter updates the row count but no “Clear Filters” button shows up.
